roadmap.title: Theming: visual flourishes (background art, themed fonts, a Skyrim-flavored Get Started guide)
roadmap.note: Director, thinking out loud while reviewing Phase 2 (2026-08-15): maybe a background image per theme, themed fonts for tool names, and a Skyrim-themed "Get Started" book reusing the release banner art to explain what each tool really does in more depth. Captured only -- not scoped or built. Needs its own mock-up before any build work (standing order for big UI/visual changes), and probably its own round of Gemini asset generation for backgrounds/book art.

roadmap.title: Theming: a real color picker + background color picker
roadmap.note: Director, same session (2026-08-15): on top of a full game theme (accent + brand strings), let the user pick their own accent color and background color directly, not just choose between Plain/Skyrim. Captured only -- not scoped or built. Real design questions before this can be speced: how it interacts with Appearance's existing light/dark accent split (plain.json currently needs a matched accentLight/accentHoverLight/accentBgLight trio per DESIGN.md's Phase 2 notes -- a free-form picker would need the same derivation, or the user picks per-mode); whether a custom color becomes its own saved "theme" or a per-user override layered on top of whichever brand theme is active; and where it lives in Settings (probably beside the new Style picker in General). Needs a mock-up before any build (standing order for big UI changes).
